name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NoiseHandle.floor_sub_carry
title: Rounding commutes with differences up to a carry of at most 1
statement: For real a and b, floor(a) - floor(b) equals floor(a - b) or floor(a - b) + 1. Applied coordinatewise to the master-side and constrained-side values a, b of a rounding-based (BV15/BKM-type) PRF evaluation, the difference of the rounded values is the rounding of the unrounded difference up to a carry in {0, 1}, at every path. So rounding cannot create a validity gate that the linear difference does not already have: a gate obtained by moving rounded PRF outputs into an error is a gate on the unrounded linear difference.
